programmes.d: The squad looks for answers in Stroh's past, hunting for the former Ms. Bechtel. Meanwhile, Provenza struggles with Chief Mason, and Rusty is frustrated with his proximity to Gus.
Phillip Stroh and his accomplice edge closer to their end game, while Lt. Provenza pushes Asst. Chief Leo Mason into adding resources to the case. Rusty digs up an important clue.
Tao is stuck in a room with a potential bomb. Provenza finally identifies the real Ms. Bechtel, and Major Crimes comes face-to-face for the very last time with Phillip Stroh.
In the series premiere, the Major Crimes department is still reeling with the newly appointed head of the unit, Captain Sharon Raydor (series star Mary McDonnell).
There are growing pains within Major Crimes as the division works to obtain justice in a brutal homicide. The changes within the department may be more than Provenza can accept.
The facts blur regarding a fatal car crash at a nightclub.
A homicide case involving the Israeli mob and a self-proclaimed "intuitive life strategist" leads Major Crimes to partner with the FBI.
DDA Andrea Hobbs becomes a valuable resource in a case. Plus, DNA evidence proves that Rusty is more closely connected to the justice system than anyone thought.
Captain Raydor makes a bold move that could jeopardize her career and put Sykes in harm's way. Meanwhile, Rusty makes it clear that he doesn't care to meet his biological father.
Major Crimes has a tough time keeping important confidential facts from leaking. Plus, the Department of Children and Family Services makes a shocking discovery concerning Rusty.

As the team tries to track down the terrorists behind the bombing that injured Gibbs, they learn that the terrorist group is planning another bombing of 9-11 magnitude--and that Gibbs has information about their plan.

As each team member deals with the absence of a retired Gibbs, Ziva's past comes back to haunt her when she inadvertently witnesses the assassination of a military attaché by her former Mossad partner.
When a convict from FBI Agent Fornell's past escapes and threatens not only him but his young daughter, Gibbs comes out of retirement to re-open the convict's armed robbery case.

After the team learns a missing Navy lieutenant had been profiling men to find herself the perfect mate, they trace the woman's path and discover she planned to attend a singles seminar at a local hotel.
The NCIS team is called to the scene of a bizarre murder of a Petty Officer who was part of an undercover arms operation.
When the team investigates the case of a dead Lance Corporal found by a real estate agent, they realize the body was buried in the backyard and then exhumed.
After receiving a ransom call from the kidnapper of a Marine's daughter, the NCIS team learns that the girl's parents were recently separated after a marital indiscretion by the wife.
When an explosion kills a Marine Colonel on a military golf course, the NCIS team must work together with the Army Criminal Investigative Unit to find the killer.
When a murder conviction is overturned after eight years, Tao questions his past actions. Rusty tries to be himself during his first outing with his dad, Daniel Dunn.

A man is found dead, but the facts become unclear as gritty details unfold. A series of strange events leaves Rusty and Raydor wondering if Dunn can be trusted.
In the season finale, when a peaceful ceremony turns deadly, Major Crimes and the FBI team up to track down a sniper.
In the season premiere, the squad scrambles to get a confession when the pregnant wife of a big-time film director is found murdered. New Deputy D.A. Emma Rios challenges Raydor.
A complex murder-suicide case has the department reeling. Meanwhile, when Rusty receives a mysterious and threatening letter, Emma demands that he be relocated.
A meddling television writer/producer (BEN FELDMAN - Mad Men) accompanies Sanchez and Tao on a simple ride-along ... that quickly gets out of hand.
The LAPD flies a material witness into Los Angeles to testify, but, in a horrible turn of events, the witness winds up as the key suspect in an entirely new murder.
